title: A PROBLEM-REPORT TEXT BOX IN THE PAUSE MENU
why: His Q9 (2026-10-18): a text box in the pause menu, or chat, both carry the same weight. The pause menu only had a Feedback button that opened a window. It now has a Report a problem box right in the menu: type, press Feedback (it reads Send feedback) or CTRL+ENTER, and the note is saved through the same save as the Feedback window with the version and a screenshot. An empty box still opens the window. A pad steps onto the box with the D-pad and A focuses it. Q61: the feedback line, the button and Send play data are kept.
now: The pause menu has a Report a problem box. Type, press Send feedback, and the note goes out with a screenshot and the version.
